profile.summary: The Public Service Center is a unit of the University of California, Berkeley. It brings together students, faculty and community groups to support social justice, civic engagement and social change. It runs student community service programs and internships, including the Berkeley College Corps, a fellowship in which students serve with community partner organizations.
